  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →

      0 < h →

                      σ ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)
              (σ⁻¹ *
                ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                  ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1
                      ((RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e j - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) x) /
                        σ) *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u

                        (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) /

                      j
                      ((RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e j - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) x) /
                        σ) ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)
              0
